n = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007
dp = [[0] * (2 * n + 1) for _ in range(2 * n + 1)]

dp[1][1] = 1

for i in range(2, 2 * n + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j > 0:
            dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - 1]
            dp[i][j] %= MOD
        if j < 2 * n:
            dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j + 1]
            dp[i][j] %= MOD

total = 0
for i in range(2 * n - 1, -1, -2):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if 2 * n - i >= j:
            total += dp[i][j]
            total %= MOD

print(total)
</translated_code>
